events.title: Grammys 2027: Best Pop Duo/Group Performance Nominations
events.description:
The GRAMMY Awards are presented annually by the Recording Academy. For the 69th Annual GRAMMY Awards, nominations are scheduled for November 16, 2026, and the ceremony for February 7, 2027.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed performance is nominated for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance at the 69th Annual GRAMMY Awards. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". If a performance is not officially nominated for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance when the 69th Annual GRAMMY Awards nominees are announced, the corresponding market will immediately resolve to "No".

If, for any reason, no nominations are declared by February 7, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the GRAMMY Awards and the Recording Academy, including data from their website (e.g., https://www.grammy.com/) and the live broadcast of the nominations announcement; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.question: GRAMMYs 2024: Will ‘World Music Radio’ by Jon Batiste win Album of the Year?
markets.description:
The 66th GRAMMYs Awards Show, presented by the Recording Academy, is an event honoring “outstanding achievement in the music industry” for the period of time between October 1, 2022, to September 15, 2023. It is scheduled to take place at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on February 4, 2024. The nominations were announced on November 10, 2023.

If ‘World Music Radio’ by Jon Batiste wins the Grammy for Album of the Year at the 66th GRAMMYs Awards Show, this market will resolve to “Yes”. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If for any reason no winner is declared by December 31, 2024, 11:59 PM ET, or in case of a tie for winner, this market will resolve in favor of the nominated album which comes first in alphabetical order.

The resolution source will be the television broadcast of the awards and the Grammy website (https://www.grammy.com/), however other credible reporting may be used.

events.title: What will be the top global Netflix movie this week?
events.description:
Netflix is expected to update its global Top 10 movies list on top10.netflix.com on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, 3:00 PM ET, reflecting viewership from the previous week (Monday to Sunday).

This market will resolve based on which movie this update ranks as the #1 global Netflix movie. If multiple movies tie for #1, this market will resolve according to the movie whose listed title comes first alphabetically.

The ranking is based on total views globally, as reported by Netflix for Global Top 10 Movies (English only).

If the top10.netflix.com update does not occur by October 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".
